notes: Playtest fixes: Inventory now leads with Databite and Medicine (the two you actually tap Use on there), not the capture programs.
The main screen box is noticeably bigger on tall phones — it was capped at 400px regardless of screen size.
The Recycle Entity button now shows exactly what it counts toward and your live progress, instead of only showing up in the log afterward.
Fixed: a monster caught already past its evolution level no longer shows a stale "Evolves at LvX" — it (and anyone one level away from evolving) now shows "Evolves next level-up".
The Server Farm's Grow-Pods are now paged 6 at a time instead of one long scroll.
